BiblicalUsage: Adina is named once, in the list of David's mighty men: 'Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him.' That is all Scripture says — a name, a father, a tribe, a rank, and thirty men under him.
TheologicalSignificance: This is a name in a roster, not a teaching, and I won't stretch it into one. Its quiet value is that God counted the captains as well as the kings — thirty men, one captain, and a name the record did not let go of.
